summary.text: Lou Juris (listed by Ballotpedia as Louis Juris) is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 7, where he assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer, he serves on the Public Works and Highways Committee.

paragraphs.text: Louis Juris lives in Nashua, New Hampshire, and graduated from Nashua High School.
He earned a degree from Northeastern University, and his career experience includes working on the engineering staff of the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority in Boston.
Juris's 2023-2024 committee assignment was the Public Works and Highways Committee.
